# RTK routing instructions

<!-- Generated by scripts/eif_generate_rtk_guidance.py from command-registry.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Registry version: `1.0.0`. Tested RTK: `0.43.0`.

Correctness precedes compression. A route is savings-eligible only when its canary passes.

- `git-native`: `rtk git <subcommand> <args>` - savings-eligible; argv: preserved.
- `grep-simple`: `rtk grep <pattern> <paths>` - savings-eligible; argv: preserved.
  The provider must pass the grep canary before an empty result is trusted.
- `grep-alternation`: `rtk grep -e <A> -e <B> <paths>` - savings-eligible; argv: split-alternation.
  Do not pass a literal pipe in one pattern on the tested Windows build.
- `read-bounded`: `rtk read --max-lines <N> <path>` - savings-eligible; argv: preserved.
  Use exactly one of --max-lines and --tail-lines.
- `generic-space-free`: `rtk summary <tool> <space-free-args>` - savings-eligible; argv: space-free-only.
- `quoted-whitespace`: `rtk proxy <tool> <args> # rtk-raw-ok: preserve argv` - zero savings; argv: raw-explicit.
  Correctness takes priority; raw proxy contributes zero estimated savings.
- `no-native-subcommand`: `unsupported - choose summary or explicit proxy from this registry` - zero savings; argv: not-applicable.
  Silent raw fallback is a parse failure, not a filtered route.
- `proxy-explicit`: `rtk proxy <tool> <args> # rtk-raw-ok: <reason>` - zero savings; argv: raw-explicit.
  Never report proxy output reduction as RTK savings.

The framework never installs hooks or mutates user-level configuration. Apply any generated guidance manually after review.
